pre_rig_audit.feature_family_purity: CLEAN (pure-timing = req_to_resp_ms only; req_to_ack_event_ms flagged mode-coupled, excluded from the pure claim; no is_separate/packet-count/missingness/size leak)
pre_rig_audit.scheduler_error_finding: FIXED creates a ~0.19 ms device-correlated guard-delta residual (separate profile's response released a scheduler-guard after its pure ACK) -- a new timing signal the defense itself introduces.
pre_rig_audit.verdict: BOUNDED closes the pure-timing channel to chance (0.302, CI spans 0.333); FIXED leaves a residual (0.616, CI strictly above chance) because the deterministic guard delta re-encodes ACK mode into response timing. DESIGN CONSEQUENCE: operate DCRN in BOUNDED mode; FIXED alone is insufficient for the separate profile. Mode + size remain out-of-scope residual channels (all ~0.99).
pre_rig_audit.rig_must_confirm: whether the 0.19 ms guard residual survives real switched-path jitter (loopback-only measurement), RTO re-measure on the real master, per-profile picture on physical NICs / kernel 6.8 / Vision-side capture; re-run this exact audit on the rig PCAPs, reported per-profile not pooled.

architecture_plan.control_point: tc ingress eBPF (arm request state, pick class-independent deadline) + tc egress eBPF (classify pure ACK vs ACK-bearing response, assign skb EDT) + fq qdisc (release at EDT). On loopback both directions share one egress path (single-egress simplification, per the existing ack_edt.c).
architecture_plan.reuse: reports/phases/phase_04/ebpf_prototype/ack_edt.c (single-egress, separate-mode, fixed 20/40ms) is the starting point; DCRN generalizes it to dual-case + calibrated class-independent target + per-flow deadline arming from the request + the full bypass/fail-open set.
architecture_plan.why_better_than_phase02: the egress scheduler holds packets AFTER the kernel already selected separate/combined, so timing normalization cannot accidentally change the ACK mode (Phase 02's application-write delay can).

two_host_rig.byte_preservation: holds by construction (DCRN writes only skb->tstamp); 0 retrans over 15 runs empirically confirms RTO-safe targets
two_host_rig.verdict: DCRN mechanism CONFIRMED on physical hardware (kernel 6.8, real NICs, switched path): normalizes both native structures to target, byte-clean, order-safe, deadline-clean, 0 retrans/reset. The FIXED guard-delta residual SURVIVES real-path jitter (pure-timing 0.740, above chance, ~= native 0.731). DCRN_COMMON_BOUNDED closes the timing channel on the rig (0.289, CI spans chance) -- same as loopback. Confirmed design conclusion: operate DCRN in BOUNDED mode; FIXED alone does not reduce timing leakage. Mode + size persist (all=1.0) -- DCRN's out-of-scope residuals.
two_host_rig.caveats: smaller sample than loopback (n=88-114, wider CIs); 1G mgmt path not 25G Tofino; READ-only single-outstanding loss-free; physical three-device hardware still a separate external-validation line. Higher RUNS would tighten CIs (cheap follow-up).
